function.arguments: {"research_topic":"Investigate, using only authoritative and directly retrievable evidence, whether and how the March 2022 Ronin Bridge theft and the June 2022 Harmony Horizon Bridge theft can be defensibly linked to Lazarus Group and/or APT38. Produce a source-grounded evidence dossier for a later report: identify the theft events, dates, amounts only if explicitly supported, public attribution statements and their exact provenance, and distinguish confirmed facts from allegations or analytical assessments. Compare cryptocurrency laundering and fund-movement patterns, including mixers, chain hopping, bridges, peeling or consolidation patterns, timing, and any similarities, but do not infer a relationship unless a source supports it. Identify wallet addresses, transaction hashes or clusters, infrastructure, exchange deposits, malware or operational indicators, and any explicit or implicit relationships to Lazarus Group or APT38, preserving exact source IDs returned by your research system. Record contradictions, competing attributions, uncertainty, and important absences. Do not invent wallet labels, relationship names, dates, amounts, or source IDs. The final consumer requires citations solely as the source IDs returned by the tool, so return a clearly organized list of source IDs with what each source supports and quote or precisely paraphrase relevant evidence. Focus on primary government statements, sanctions or law-enforcement records, court documents, bridge/operator postmortems, blockchain analytics reports, and reputable investigative reporting where necessary."}
function.name: ConductResearch
